title: Symmetric Semantic-Transaction Measurement Bridge
purpose: Close the R73 asymmetric-measurement defect by realizing Control and Treatment into the same scene-level semantic transaction and protected-contribution representation, then applying the exact frozen R68 F04 and R69 F06 rules symmetrically.
research_questions: Can one deterministic bridge map both exact-R69 Control scenes and unchanged-F05 Treatment scenes into the same R68 F04 semantic-transaction schema without arm-specific fields or scoring logic?
Can the same bridged scene graphs be scored by the exact R69 F06 protected-contribution removal/merge rules on both arms?
On all 17 R73-Stage-A HIGH cases that never received R73 Treatment, does unchanged F05 reduce F04 semantic repetition without worsening F06 scene necessity or required causal coverage?
exact_control: Exact R69 adaptive_showrunner_ul16 output on the frozen case input, rerun only to recover full scene-level structure; no Control mutation.
exact_treatment: Exact unchanged R72 F05 Adaptive Pressure Allocator R2 SHA256 9aa36906be260b3ae734340e0d9be951692a18088bc1a40ae5c829e166088c0f.

shared_bridge.arm_blind_rule: The bridge receives only scene graph + obligation/atom metadata; no Control/Treatment flag may affect projection or validation.
shared_bridge.f04_rule: For non-RESOLVE scenes, same normalized five-field signature >=3 occurrences in one episode graph is SEMANTIC_TRANSACTION_REPEAT_GE3. One/two occurrences allowed; RESOLVE excluded.
shared_bridge.f06_rule: NECESSARY_SEPARATE_SCENE iff removal causes protected loss and no lossless adjacent merge exists; otherwise REDUNDANT_OR_MERGEABLE_SCENE. Adjacent merge requires same sequence, same obligation-id set, compatible deferred/delta roles, and no two distinct transaction stages in one merged scene.
shared_bridge.symmetry_requirement: Exact same bridge code, exact same F04 code, exact same F06 code, exact same thresholds for both arms.

sample_rule.rationale: Use every R73 Stage-A HIGH case that was not selected into the R73 Stage-B Treatment cohort. No outcome-based subsampling is allowed.
sample_rule.limitation: Control was observed previously in R73 Stage A; Treatment is fresh. Therefore R74 is a bridge/paired-signal study, not a clean fully-fresh qualification study.

A_bridge_qualification.purpose: Validate projection/measurement symmetry before any primary paired efficacy claim.
gates: A1 arm-label invariance: swapping arm labels changes 0 projected fields and 0 verdicts
A2 identical input graph yields bit-identical bridged representation and F04/F06 result
A3 R68 F04 canonical metrology cases = 16/16 correct
A4 R69 F06 canonical metrology cases = 16/16 correct
A6 bridge projection loss = 0 for required F04/F06 fields

B_paired_signal.prerequisite: All Stage-A gates PASS and 17-case ledger sealed before Treatment outputs.

gates.B2_bridge_symmetry: 17/17 both arms successfully represented by identical bridge
gates.B5_f04_effect: Treatment F04 semantic repetition group count < Control in at least 12/17 cases
gates.B6_f04_nonworsening: Treatment F04 count <= Control in at least 16/17 cases
gates.B7_f06_nonworsening: Treatment REDUNDANT_OR_MERGEABLE count <= Control in at least 16/17 cases

prohibited_changes: Do not alter R68 F04 signature fields, threshold >=3, or RESOLVE exclusion.
Do not alter R69 F06 protected contributions, removal/merge logic, or atomicity rule.
Do not tune the F05 allocator.
Do not select a subset of the 17 cases after seeing Treatment outputs.
Do not use arm identity in bridge projection or scoring.
Do not reinterpret R72 or R73 as PASS.
Do not claim Production promotion, F05 qualification, Level-3 restoration, or screenplay-surface quality from R74 alone.
claim_boundary: At most, R74 can qualify the symmetric F04/F06 measurement bridge and establish a paired planning-layer signal on a Treatment-fresh but Control-previously-observed 17-case cohort. Full F05 qualification requires a later fully fresh independent replication.
